text_block_list.text:
One day, while holding a review meeting
with Mejiro Dober in the Trainer's Office—

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: Trainer, do you have a moment?

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Today, I have come to bring
good news to Trainer and Mejiro Dober.

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Actually... the URA has decided to award
Mejiro Dober the title of
"Best Senior Queen Umamusume"!

"Best Queen Umamusume" is a title awarded to Umamusume
who excelled in races like the Hanshin JF,
the Triple Tiara, and the Queen Elizabeth II Cup.

Slots have been established for the Junior, Classic, and Senior stages,
which means this time Mejiro Dober will be selected for the Senior Class...!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: A Queen Umamusume of the Senior Class...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: I did it...!!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text:
Congratulations♪
The award ceremony will be held at a later date,
so it might be a good idea to prepare your comments in advance!

text_block_list.name: Tazuna Hayakawa
text_block_list.text: I'm sure lots of people will see it♪

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Understood.
choice_data_list: Let's show them our dignified selves.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Yeah. We need to prepare properly...!
And on the day of the awards ceremony—

Mejiro Dober delivered her remarks on stage
confidently and without a single misstep...!

text_block_list.name: Applause
text_block_list.text: (Clap clap clap clap clap clap—)

text_block_list.name: Male Reporter
text_block_list.text:
She has truly developed an imposing presence, hasn't she?
She truly feels like a new queen...

text_block_list.name: Female Reporter
text_block_list.text: I'm truly looking forward to seeing how she performs from here on out.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A presentation! A bouquet from an academy junior
to her great predecessor!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: C-Congratulations...!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Thank you.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Ah, u-um! Mejiro Dober-senpai!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Hm?

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: I... um, S-Senpai... I've always admired you!!

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: "So that I can become like you, Senpai... um... I-I'll do my best!!"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu, thanks.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Still, you don't have to turn out like me.

text_block_list.name: Junior Umamusume
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"You have your own brilliance.
So you can... keep doing your best just as you are."

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
I'll be waiting.
To race against the true you.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: ...Fufu.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
"I-It's really not that big of a deal.
It's just—"

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
...Was I grinning?
I couldn't help it, I'm just so happy.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Someone looks up to me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text: Someone looks up to me, huh...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Dober
text_block_list.text:
Just as Air Groove-senpai was to me...
I have to work hard so I can stay someone people look up to, too...!
And so, the award ceremony concluded successfully, leaving everyone with a deep sense of Mejiro Dober's journey so far...!
